channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: USA's 2026 Olympic Women's Hockey Team Could Be The Best Ever Assembled
item.description: Team USA has a unique overlap of surefire Hockey Hall of Famers nearing the end of their careers and budding stars just getting started. Their games against Canada this year is something special.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey Power Rankings: Canada Hold The Edge On Paper
item.description: As the puck drops for men's hockey at the 2026 Olympics, these power rankings examine the squads on paper. Two things are for sure: the powerhouses have spectacular talents, but the underdogs have upset potential.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: More Blues Trades Coming, Latest Maple Leafs Buzz
item.description: The Blues' trade of Nick Bjugstad before the Olympic break could be the first of several moves by them before the trade deadline, while speculation is growing over which players the Toronto Maple Leafs could peddle.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Slovakia's Juraj Slafkovsky Scores The First Goal Of The Tournament
item.description: Juraj Slafkovsky led the 2022 Olympics in goal-scoring. He's already at it again for Slovakia in the 2026 men's hockey tournament.

item.title: Olympics: Canada Coach Praises Jordan Binnington, But Will He Play Him?
item.description: Jon Cooper said Jordan Binnington delivered for Canada at the 4 Nations Face-Off. Whether the goalie delivers again at the Olympics is impossible to say, if he even gets the chance.

item.title: NHL Nugget: Remembering Ryan Miller's Stellar 2010 Olympics
item.description: Team USA goalie Ryan Miller was very difficult to beat during the 2010 Olympics, but even after losing the gold medal game in overtime, he stood tall.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: Excitement Builds For Team Canada
item.description: Ryan Kennedy and Michael Traikos are in Milan discussing Canada before their opening game, while Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello recap Slovakia's win over Finland

item.title: Italy Score First On Sweden In Olympic Men's Hockey
item.description: Despite losing the game, Team Italy brought the home crowd to their feet by scoring the first goal of the match against powerhouse Sweden and adding another goal in the second period.

item.title: Olympic Hockey: Does Team Finland Have A Renewed Juuse Saros Problem?
item.description: After a rough showing at the 4 Nations Face-Off, Finland's Juuse Saros was outperformed by an AHL goalie in a 4-1 loss to Team Slovakia at the Olympics.

item.title: Matthew And Brady Tkachuk Could Dominate For Team USA After Dealing With Injuries
item.description: Team USA brother act Matthew and Brady Tkachuk are rooming together at the Olympic Village, and if they can stay healthy despite playing a robust style of game, Olympic gold-medal glory could be in the cards for them.
